director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj perimeter padhenge—cricket ground ke chaaron taraf ki boundary jaisa. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Badhiya, Riya—cricket ground ki boundary karo: uske chaaron taraf ek round lagane par kitni distance hogi? Andaza batao; ant mein Golu ko samjhaogi.
Haan Riya, lesson ek minute ruk sakta hai. Tum kis baare mein baat karna chahti ho? Iske baad perimeter par lautenge.
Riya, rectangle ki boundary ki total length perimeter hoti hai. Ismein 50 m aur 30 m ki chaar sides jodni hain. Total batao.
Isko ek baar poora karke dekhte hain. Diya hai: 3, 50 m aur 30 m. Pehle: 2 × (50 + 30) = 2 × 80 = 160 m. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
Riya, table par rectangle ke chaaron sides ki lambai dekho; har side-gap gino. Tumhe total kitne gaps dikh rahe hain?
Riya, hum dono rectangle ki boundary trace karte hain. Tum ek side ke gaps ginogi, main agla side ginungi. Tumne kitne gaps gine?
Riya, boring lag raha hai—chalo mode badlein. Screen par choose karo: picture, mini-story, ya perimeter race. Kaunsa try karein?
Riya, inmein se ek chuno: Picture dikhao, Kahani mein batao, ya Game khelte hain. Tum kya choose karogi?
Ek din Meena rectangle ke chaaron taraf chali: pehle 50 m, phir 30 m, phir wahi do sides. Total boundary ke liye kaunsi sides jodengi?
Theek hai Riya, ruk sakte hain. Tum chuno: lesson jaari rakhein, chhota break lein, ya aaj ke liye band karein?
